ValidationRule.description: Prevents non-administrative support agents from downgrading Critical priority tickets, while allowing System Administrators to reclassify if necessary.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator', NOT($Permission.Bypass_Case_Lock), TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Priority)) = 'Critical', TEXT(Priority) != 'Critical' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Rule Violation: Critical priority cases cannot be downgraded by support agents. Only System Administrators can reclassify a Critical priority incident.
